general.title: General
general.description: Name, language and currency used across the organization.
general.name: Organization name
general.currencyHint: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD or EUR. New customers inherit it.
general.slug: Sign-in identifier: {{slug}} — changed by the platform operator only.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Defaults for everyone in the organization. People can override their own time zone in user settings.
calendar.timeZoneHint: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Kyiv. Used for people who have not set their own.
calendar.durationHint: Used when a new event is created from the grid.
calendar.reminderHint: Applied to new timed events. Set 0 to remind at the start.
calendar.allDayReminderHint: 900 means 09:00 on the previous day — the same default Google uses.

numbering.title: Numbering
numbering.description: How human-readable numbers are issued for your records.
numbering.paddingHint: Pads with leading zeros: 6 turns 123 into 000123.
numbering.startValueHint: Used for the first record only. Once numbering has started, use the field below.
numbering.nextNumberHint: Can only move forward — earlier numbers are already issued. Use it after importing records from another system.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: The persona and instructions the AI assistant follows for everyone in the organization.
ai.providerNotice: The persona and instructions are sent to the external AI provider together with every question anyone in the organization asks. Do not put passwords, keys or personal data here.
ai.personaPlaceholder: You are Ava, the helpdesk assistant of Acme.
ai.personaHint: Who the assistant is and how it sounds. Up to {{max}} characters.
ai.instructionsPlaceholder: Mention that urgent requests go to the helpdesk. Prefer step-by-step lists.
ai.instructionsHint: What to emphasize, tone and level of detail. Up to {{max}} characters.
ai.boundaries: The assistant's built-in limits always apply and cannot be changed here: it has no access to your data, cannot perform actions, does not guess beyond the documentation, and answers in the language of the question.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Who changed the organization settings, and when.
